{{Quote|Morvis, pass the word for Chief Viddarie. See if he can find some binders for our young guest.|Admiral Saul Karath, calling for Viddarie to restrain Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor15" />}}
'''Viddarie''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] that served with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during [[Mandalorian Wars]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans. Around [[3963 BBY]], Viddarie was the security [[Chief/Legends|chief]] aboard the Republic [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|battleship]] [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Viddarie was ordered to place the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] in [[Binders/Legends|binders]] while both were aboard the ''Courageous''.

==Biography==
Around [[3963 BBY]]<ref name="kotor15 date">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]] dates its story to around 3963 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Since the [[The New Essential Chronology]] dates the battle to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the comic must take place around [[3963 BBY]].</ref> Viddarie served as the security [[Chief/Legends|chief]] on the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|battleship]] [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']], serving under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]]. Viddarie was present on the ''Courageous'' when the ship traveled with a [[Battle Group Serroco|battle group]] to protect the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serroco]] from attack during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans.<ref name="kotor15" /> While the ''Courageous'' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] Serroco, fugitive former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] bluffed his way onto the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], hoping to warn Admiral Karath of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] he had of the Mandalorians [[Battle of Serroco|destroying]] the planet. Karath recognized Carrick immediately, and ordered Viddarie to place the Jedi in [[Binders/Legends|binders]] while proclaiming him to be a Mandalorian [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="kotor15" />

==Personality and traits==
Viddarie was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] with a tail and light [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin that was covered in small tentacle-like protrusions.<ref name="kotor15" /> 

==Equipment==
While aboard the ''Courageous'', Viddarie carried binders and wore a blue Republic Navy uniform that included grey [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], grey [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]], an orange [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]], an orange [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], orange thigh guards, and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. A hole was cut in the back of his uniform to accommodate his tail.<ref name="kotor15" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viddarie appeared in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|fifteenth issue]] of [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]], illustrated by [[Dustin Weaver]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]],<ref name="kotor15" /> and released on [[April 4]], [[2007]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-396/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-15|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #15}}</ref>
